ui_bugs.issue: briefing_time TextInput does not persist on web. Root cause: uses `defaultValue={cfg.briefing_time}` + `onEndEditing={(e) => save({ briefing_time: e.nativeEvent.text })}`. On react-native-web, `e.nativeEvent.text` is often empty/undefined so save() is called with empty string (or the save is a no-op). Verified: typing 07:45 → Tab → reload → still 07:30. Same issue affects proactive-weekly-time, proactive-quiet-start, proactive-quiet-end (all use identical pattern lines 67, 85, 107, 109). Reference: /app/frontend/src/ProactiveSettingsCard.tsx:67. Suggested fix: use controlled state like NumField pattern (local useState + onBlur reading from state), NOT e.nativeEvent.text.

action_items: Fix persistence for time TextInputs in ProactiveSettingsCard.tsx (briefing_time, weekly_report_time, quiet_start, quiet_end). Replace `onEndEditing={(e) => save({ key: e.nativeEvent.text })}` with a controlled input (local useState + onBlur/onSubmitEditing reading from the state variable). Pattern already correctly used by NumField in the same file — reuse it or clone the same idea for HH:mm strings.

rca_of_issue: briefing_time persistence bug — In ProactiveSettingsCard.tsx line 67: `<TextInput defaultValue={cfg.briefing_time} onEndEditing={(e) => save({ briefing_time: e.nativeEvent.text })} ... testID='proactive-briefing-time' />`. On react-native-web `onEndEditing`'s SyntheticEvent shape does not populate `nativeEvent.text` the same way as native, so `e.nativeEvent.text` is undefined/empty → save() writes an empty string (or gets rejected server-side) → config unchanged. inactive_days uses NumField which stores value in local state `v` and reads it in `onBlur`/`onSubmitEditing` — this works. Reproduction: 1) Login as test@dalpastro.it. 2) Open /axon-notifications?tab=prefs. 3) Focus proactive-briefing-time, clear, type '07:45', Tab out. 4) Reload page. 5) Field is still 07:30 (unchanged). Mitigation: replace the 4 time TextInputs with controlled components (local state + explicit onBlur that reads from state).
